note: Gold Skulltula hash to OoTR name table, 2026-11-13. One row for each of the 46 skulltula hashes that the catalog could not pin, plus the two Zora's River pool hashes so a stricter rule can follow one of them. The name is our own conclusion from comparing the remake hashes with an outside map and with our own positions, ages and rules. grade release: shuffled in matched mode under this name. grade lean: the name is likely but not settled. grade tour: the name is a placeholder until someone checks the spot in the game. A row here replaces the catalog hash of its name for skulltula drops. The rules list holds stricter rules that the logic uses while skulltula shuffle is on, each one at least as strict as the rule it replaces. See the skullrelease notes.
